description: This file defines an in-memory implementation of the INotesRepository interface for managing Note objects in a thread-safe manner using ConcurrentDictionary. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes asynchronously.

classes.name: InMemoryNotesRepository
classes.description: A thread-safe in-memory repository for storing notes, implementing the INotesRepository interface.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new note, assigning creation and update timestamps, and stores it in the dictionary.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Removes a note by its ID from the store.

methods.name: ExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks if a note with the specified ID exists in the store.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all notes, ordered by most recent update.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing note and sets the last updated timestamp.
